description: Power Apps canvas expert: checks every change before Microsoft's canvas-apps plugin applies it, guided live edits (/appforge:edit-app), app surveys, control and Power Fx reference.

compile_gate.title: Compile gate
compile_gate.description: block (default): stop a compile when AppForge finds a REFUSE. warn: allow every compile but report what AppForge found. off: no check and no post-compile reminder.
